title: [review] 03-adaptation.md: Rule 1 compressed size inconsistent
description: States Rule 1 has '26B SCHC header' but appendix-schc.md line 13 shows Rule 1 (Global IPv6 + UDP + CoAP) has '~42 bytes residue' with 'full addresses value-sent (128 bit each)'. The main doc describes mesh-local with MSB(64)/LSB(64) (sending only IIDs), while appendix shows global with full 128-bit addresses. Either the rule definitions are out of sync or this is describing different rules.
